name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Python for data science and AI
Transformers such as BERT, GPT and LLaMA
Frameworks including Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, RAG and LangChain
Building and deploying AI applications with Flask
reading.format: A 16 course series delivered online through Coursera, with hands-on labs, projects, practical evaluations and a guided project. The page says it takes about 6 months and is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: This is a Professional Certificate made up of a 16 course series from IBM, offered on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, covering large language models, natural language processing, machine learning and deep learning with Python. Learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents and chatbots, and finish with a guided project creating a real world gen AI application. The certificate is described as an employer recognized career credential.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It states no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner.
reading.prerequisites: The page states no prior experience is required and lists the level as beginner with recommended experience.
